answer.reason: Ashdod is the Philistine city where the captured ark of God was taken, Dagon fell before it and the LORD struck the people, and it was later taken by Tartan.

clauses.english: was where the captured ark of God was set beside Dagon, who fell on his face before it
clauses.quote: Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD

clauses.english: was struck by the hand of the LORD with emerods while the ark was there
clauses.quote: the hand of the LORD was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and he destroyed them

clauses.english: was fought against and taken by Tartan, sent by Sargon king of Assyria
clauses.quote: fought against Ashdod, and took it

doubts: ACT 8:40 names Azotus (Greek form of Ashdod), where Philip was found; left out as a different spelling and not an event of the place.
2CH 26:6 (Uzziah breaking down the wall of Ashdod) was left out as a lesser event, as were the prophetic threats in Amos, Zephaniah and Zechariah.
